Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandmother” and traced the line to the father’s father’s mother (Antoine de Bourbon’s mother, Françoise d’Alençon) instead of the father’s mother. Gaston’s father is Henry IV, whose mother is Jeanne d’Albret; thus the correct paternal grandmother is Jeanne d’Albret. This was a genealogical reasoning error that contradicted earlier established lineage.
